listing.name: Monster Hunter Tri — OceanTriRecomp (krisztsa)
listing.summary: Upstream presents a native game runtime with integrated graphics, controls and save management; this README does not give a complete-playthrough result. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own supported RMHP08 ISO or RVZ. Select or extract the image using the upstream setup from a copy you are permitted to use.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Upstream documents source preparation with CMake 3.22 or later, Ninja and a C++20 Clang or Visual Studio 2022 toolchain. Follow the project guide for the setup and files required by your copy.

warnings: Upstream presents a native game runtime with integrated graphics, controls and save management; this README does not give a complete-playthrough result.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.

restrictions.explanation: The v1.9.5 Windows ZIP includes original Monster Hunter Tri Wii disc files, including the RMHP08 boot header and main.dol. Portcove downloads are paused until a clean upstream package is reviewed.
